name: v1.6.9-analyze-session1
network: loopback (127.0.0.1), both instances on this Mac
kept: s1 to s5 only, 10 runs each, run under the original launch with both windows visible at 50 frames a second.
discarded: s6, s7, both soaks and the whole sweep. After s5 the Mac's 5-minute screensaver covered both windows (macOS throttled them to 20 fps). After it was dismissed, WindowServer and WallpaperAerials, the aerial wallpaper animation, used about 48% of a core for the rest of the night; every later run drew 27 to 31 frames a second instead of 50 and 25% to 46% of host ticks were late. Those 60 runs are kept in Bench/runs/ on the benchmark machine but are not comparable to the baseline and are not in this data set.
instrument: P0a fog memory compared only in fog; P0b resources digest counts the builder's carried mine; P1 drawn-position probe; render hop split into wait and work, and the render closure into hopRender, hopHud and hopLiveState.
conditions_added: A benchmark session needs the screensaver off (or a keep-awake loop, now in run-baseline.sh) and a still wallpaper. Check host.frames_per_s is about 50 in the warm-up before trusting a session.
